html:
G'oya

Ikki to'plam teng bo'lishi uchun har biri ikkinchisining qismi bo'lishi kerak. A EXCEPT B bo'sh bo'lsa, A dagi hamma mahsulot B da bor. Xuddi shuni teskari tomonga ham tekshiramiz. EXCEPT takrorlarni o'zi olib tashlaydi, shuning uchun bir mahsulot ikki qatorda yozilgani hech narsani buzmaydi.

Yechim

SELECT a.order_id AS order_a, b.order_id AS order_b
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT order_id FROM order_items) a
JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT order_id FROM order_items) b ON a.order_id < b.order_id
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT product_id FROM order_items WHERE order_id = a.order_id
    EXCEPT
    SELECT product_id FROM order_items WHERE order_id = b.order_id
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT product_id FROM order_items WHERE order_id = b.order_id
    EXCEPT
    SELECT product_id FROM order_items WHERE order_id = a.order_id
  )

a.order_id < b.order_id har juftlikni bir marta oladi va buyurtmani o'zi bilan solishtirmaydi. Namunada 4-buyurtmada 1-mahsulot ikki qatorda, lekin uning to'plami baribir {1, 2}, shuning uchun u 1 va 2 bilan juftlik beradi.

Tuzoqlar

Bitta EXCEPT faqat "qismi" ekanini tekshiradi. 1-buyurtma {1, 2} 3-buyurtma {1, 2, 3} ning qismi, lekin savatlar har xil:

Noto'g'riSELECT a.order_id AS order_a, b.order_id AS order_b
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT order_id FROM order_items) a
JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT order_id FROM order_items) b ON a.order_id < b.order_id
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT product_id FROM order_items WHERE order_id = a.order_id
  EXCEPT
  SELECT product_id FROM order_items WHERE order_id = b.order_id
)

a.order_id <> b.order_id yozilsa, har juftlik ikki marta chiqadi: (1, 2) va (2, 1).

EXCEPTga qty ni ham qo'shsangiz, 1 va 2-buyurtmalar ajralib ketadi: mahsulotlar bir xil, miqdor boshqa.

Sanash usulida qatorlarni emas, har xil mahsulotlarni sanang. {1, 1, 2} va {1, 2, 3} uchtadan qator, umumiy mahsulot qatorlari ham uchta chiqadi, lekin savatlar har xil.

Boshqa yo'l

Har bir umumiy mahsulot juftlikka bitta ochko beradi. Ochkolar soni ikkala savat hajmiga teng bo'lsa, savatlar bir xil. Bu so'rov katta jadvalda tezroq, chunki umumiy mahsuloti yo'q juftliklarni umuman ko'rmaydi:

WITH s AS (SELECT DISTINCT order_id, product_id FROM order_items),
c AS (SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM s GROUP BY order_id)
SELECT a.order_id AS order_a, b.order_id AS order_b
FROM s a
JOIN s b ON b.product_id = a.product_id AND a.order_id < b.order_id
JOIN c ca ON ca.order_id = a.order_id
JOIN c cb ON cb.order_id = b.order_id
WHERE ca.n = cb.n
GROUP BY a.order_id, b.order_id, ca.n
HAVING COUNT(*) = ca.n
